name: GCP Artifact Registry image layer link cleanup
__comment__: GAR image layers are keyed by digest and shared across projects, so this removes only the syncing project's stale links to layers. A layer no project links to any more is deleted once per sync, after every project, by the gcp_artifact_registry_orphan_cleanup.json analysis job.

statements.__comment__: Delete this project's stale RESOURCE links to layers. Matched by project endpoint rather than MatchLink properties, so links written before layers were loaded through MatchLinks are removed too.
statements.query: MATCH (:GCPProject {id: $PROJECT_ID})-[r:RESOURCE]->(:GCPArtifactRegistryImageLayer) WHERE r.lastupdated IS NULL OR r.lastupdated <> $UPDATE_TAG WITH r LIMIT $SCAN_LIMIT_SIZE CALL (r) { DELETE r } IN TRANSACTIONS OF $LIMIT_SIZE ROWS
